Code review(medium · 8 findings)
●web/charts.[correctn— tooltipHtml interpolates title and row names into HTML without escaping, regressing ECharts' default encoding — category labels come from user directory names on disk.
●web/charts.[correctn— Tooltip swatch interpolates params.color into CSS, but all bar charts use echarts LinearGradient objects for itemStyle.color, so every bar-chart tooltip dot renders as `background:[object Object]` (invisible).
●web/style.cs[correctn— New `overflow: hidden` on `.hud-theme .card` clips ECharts HTML tooltips, which are absolutely positioned inside the chart container with no confine/appendTo escape hatch.
●web/charts.[simplific— mount() adds HUD corners (default size 14/inset 4) before app.js:91's blanket per-card pass (size 12/inset 0); the existing-corner guard in hud-background.js:35 makes the app.js call a silent no-op on chart cards.
●web/style.c[correctn— The body::before CRT overlay uses `mix-blend-mode: screen`, under which its black scanline stripes and dark radial vignette are mathematical no-ops — screen(0, backdrop) = backdrop — so half the intended effect never renders.

●web/charts.[simplifica— The axis-tooltip formatter closure is copy-pasted three times (shared TOOLTIP at line 51, stackedBarChart at 148, groupedBarChart at 187), identical except the value expression.
●web/charts[simplifica— CHART_TICK/CHART_GRID JS constants duplicate the --chart-tick/--chart-grid CSS vars (style.css:331-332) and have already drifted (tick alpha 0.48 in JS vs 0.5 in CSS); this diff hand-synced --chart-grid in both files.
●web/charts.[simplifica— lineChart's series literal has a dead `showSymbol: false` at line 114 overridden by `showSymbol: series.length <= 2` at line 116 — the later duplicate key silently wins, changing behavior from master (no symbols) to a 7px dot on every point of the Brain cache-trend line.


Review concluído — 8 findings reportados (medium effort: 8 angles × até 6 candidatos → dedup → 11 verificados: 7 CONFIRMED, 3 PLAUSIBLE, 1 REFUTED).

O escopo foi os 3 commits desde origin/master (retheme HUD + dispose de ECharts + remoção do files-scan). Duas boas notícias primeiro: a remoção do files scan no backend está limpa (nenhum consumidor órfão, workspace_roots ainda serve o /api/open, 92 testes passam), e o fix de dispose dos charts está correto.

Os problemas se concentram no rework de tooltips do web/charts.js e no CSS do tema HUD. Os três mais sérios: o novo tooltipHtml injeta nomes de projeto/ferramenta sem escape (regressão vs. o encoder default do ECharts — e o fmt.htmlSafe já existe no app.js), o dot colorido do tooltip vira [object Object] em todos os bar charts (gradiente passado direto pro CSS), e o novo overflow: hidden nos cards corta os tooltips na borda. Também confirmados: corners HUD aplicados duas vezes com geometrias conflitantes, metade do efeito CRT scanline matematicamente morto por causa do mix-blend-mode: screen, o formatter de tooltip triplicado, e drift entre os tokens de chart em CSS e JS (as vars CSS estão mortas — deletar é mais barato que sincronizar).

Ficaram de fora por baixa severidade/gatilho irreal: legend do donut sem scroll (só clipa com ~10+ modelos; seu DB tem 7), find() por nome duplicado no donut (gatilho artificial), e o style.css passando das ~400 linhas do CLAUDE.md.Aplique essas correções.

Now I have a clear picture. Let me apply all fixes:
Got it — I see the three biggest issues clearly now.

Let me tackle them one by one.

First, the tooltipHtml XSS: we should definitely add a simple htmlEscape helper (like the one already in app.js) and use it for the title and row names. That regression is real.

Second, the tooltip dot color: when ECharts passes a LinearGradient object as params.color, it renders as `[object Object]` in CSS. We need a helper that extracts the first color stop if it's a gradient, otherwise falls back to the string color. That should fix the invisible dots on bar charts.

Third, the overflow:hidden on `.hud-theme .card`: removing it is the cleanest fix — it was probably added to contain the corners but is now clipping tooltips. I'll also consider adding `confine: true` to the tooltip options as a belt-and-suspenders.

For the HUD corners double-application: removing the addHudCorners call from charts.js mount() makes sense — let app.js handle all cards uniformly.

The CRT mix-blend-mode: screen is definitely broken — switching to normal (or removing it) with the existing opacity should restore the intended scanline and vignette effect.
Aplicando as correções em `charts.js` e no CSS.

# aiOs-dashboard multi-agent readiness report

## 1. Scanner: discovery, parse, paths, schema, format

### Pipeline

```
cli.py / server._scan_loop
  → scan_dir(projects_root, db)
  → root.rglob("*.jsonl")
  → incremental via files(path, mtime, bytes_read)
  → scan_file → parse_record → messages + tool_calls
```

**Critical files**

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/scanner.py` | Walk + parse + incremental ingest |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/db.py` | Schema, migrations, analytics queries |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/cli.py` | Paths, `scan` / `dashboard` entrypoints |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/server.py` | HTTP API, 30s rescan, SSE |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/pricing.py` | Cost from model name + usage |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/pricing.json` | Claude-only rates |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/tests/fixtures/sample_session.jsonl` | Canonical message shape |

### Data paths / env

| What | Default / resolution |
|------|----------------------|
| Transcript root | `~/.claude/projects` |
| Override | `--projects-dir` or `CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR` |
| Layout | `<projects>/<project-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl` |
| SQLite | `~/.claude/token-dashboard.db` |
| Override | `--db` or `TOKEN_DASHBOARD_DB` |
| Host/port | `HOST` (127.0.0.1), `PORT` (8080) |
| Workspace open roots | `WORKSPACE_ROOTS` (default `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer`) |

Discovery is **not** “Claude-aware” beyond path convention: any `*.jsonl` under the projects root is a candidate. Project slug = first path segment under the root.

Incremental rules (`scan_dir`):

- Same `mtime` + `bytes_read == size` → skip  
- Grown file → resume from `bytes_read`  
- Partial last line (no trailing `\n`) → do not advance high-water mark  
- `files` stores **last fully-parsed byte offset**, not always `st_size`

### SQLite tables

| Table | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `files` | Scan cursor: path, mtime, bytes_read, scanned_at |
| `messages` | One row per transcript line (after streaming dedup) |
| `tool_calls` | Tools + synthetic `_tool_result` rows |
| `plan` | Pricing plan preference (`k`/`v`) |
| `dismissed_tips` | Tips UX |
| `memory_injections` | Written by **external** hooks, read by Brain |
| `memory_usage` | Same |

**`messages` fields (Claude-shaped):**  
`uuid` (PK), `parent_uuid`, `session_id`, `project_slug`, `cwd`, `git_branch`, `cc_version`, `entrypoint`, `type`, `is_sidechain`, `agent_id`, `timestamp`, `model`, `stop_reason`, `prompt_id`, `message_id`, token columns (`input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_create_5m/1h`), `prompt_text`, `prompt_chars`, `tool_calls_json`.

**`tool_calls`:**  
`message_uuid`, `session_id`, `project_slug`, `tool_name`, `target`, `tool_use_id`, `result_tokens`, `is_error`, `timestamp`.

There is **no** `source` / `agent_type` / multi-vendor column.

### Message format assumptions (hard-coded Claude Code)

Top-level record:

- Required: `uuid`, `type`, `sessionId`, `timestamp`
- Optional: `parentUuid`, `cwd`, `gitBranch`, `version`, `entrypoint`, `isSidechain`, `agentId`, `promptId`
- Nested: `message.model`, `message.id`, `message.stop_reason`, `message.content`, `message.usage`

Usage map (Anthropic naming):

- `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`
- `cache_read_input_tokens` → `cache_read_tokens`
- `cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` / `ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`

Content:

- User text: string or list of `{type:"text"}` blocks  
- Tools: `type:"tool_use"` with Claude names (`Read`, `Edit`, `Write`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `Bash`, `WebFetch`, `WebSearch`, `Task`, `Skill`)  
- Results: `type:"tool_result"` → synthetic `_tool_result` with `chars//4` tokens  

Streaming dedup: same `(session_id, message_id)` keeps only latest `uuid` (`_evict_prior_snapshots`).

“Subagent” support is **Claude Code Task sidechains** only (`isSidechain` / `agentId`), not other products.

---

## 2. Non-Claude agent support?

**None.** Searches for `grok`, `openai`, `cursor`, `codex`, multi-agent source types hit only:

- CSS `cursor:`
- Claude `Task` → `subagent_type`
- Memory frontmatter `source: user|auto`
- Skills `source: user|plugin`

Pricing is Claude-only (`claude-opus-*`, `claude-sonnet-*`, `claude-haiku-*` + opus/sonnet/haiku tier fallback). Non-matching models → `usd: null`.

`docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` even notes **Claude Cowork** (same vendor, different path) is invisible if it doesn’t write local JSONL.

---

## 3. Brain / memory system

### Philosophy

Disk is source of truth. Brain **does not index memories into SQLite** on scan. Each `/api/brain` call re-reads markdown from disk.

### Paths

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md` | Per-project memories |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/MEMORY.md` | Index (pointers; not a graph node) |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/LEARNINGS.md` | Dated journal |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/AUDIT.md` | Skipped |
| `~/.claude/memory/global/` | Global tier as pseudo-project `slug=global` |
| `memory/.trash/` | Quarantine target |

**Note:** Global uses `~/.claude/memory/global`, not a full catalogue under `~/.claude/memory/INDEX.md` inside this repo. The dashboard does not read `INDEX.md`; it globs `*/memory/*.md` + the global dir.

### Key modules

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `token_dashboard/memory.py` | `get_brain`, ROI, suggestions, effectiveness, quarantine/promote |
| `token_dashboard/memory_parsing.py` | Frontmatter, learnings, coverage blobs, `GLOBAL_MEM_DIR` |
| `token_dashboard/workspace.py` | Brain rings layers: MCP / routines / skills from `~/.claude` |
| `web/routes/brain.js` | UI |
| `web/rings.js` | 3D rings canvas |

### Memory file format

YAML-like frontmatter (hand-parsed, not full YAML):

```yaml
---
name: ...
description: ...
metadata:
  type: project|...
  source: user|auto
  origin_session: ...
---
body with optional [[wikilinks]]
```

### APIs

| Endpoint | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| `GET /api/brain` | `get_brain(projects_dir, db, pricing)` |
| `POST /api/brain/remove` | Quarantine → `memory/.trash/` + strip MEMORY.md pointer |
| `POST /api/brain/keep` | Promote auto → `source: user` |
| `GET /api/workspace` | `scan_workspace(~/.claude)` apps/routines/skills |
| `POST /api/open` | Open path if under `WORKSPACE_ROOTS` or `~/.claude` |

### What Brain computes from SQLite (not from memory files)

- **Suggestions:** heavy `Read`/`Grep` targets without coverage in memory text  
- **ROI:** re-read tokens on covered files vs sessions whose `prompt_text` contains `MEMORY_EXTRACTION_PASS`  
- **Effectiveness:** join `memory_injections` (mode=`rank`) + `memory_usage`  

Those injection/usage tables are filled by **hooks outside this repo** (`~/.claude/hooks/memory-inject.py`, `memory-usage.py` — referenced in comments only).

### Graph links

1. Explicit `[[wikilink]]` → name match  
2. Soft TF-overlap edges (stdlib cosine-like, threshold 0.12)

No embeddings, no separate index DB for memory content.

---

## 4. Gap analysis: second agent source

### What is locked to Claude Code

1. **Single transcript root** (`CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR` only)  
2. **One parser** (`parse_record` + Anthropic usage + Claude tool names)  
3. **Schema** without `source` / vendor  
4. **Pricing** Claude tiers only  
5. **Tips / Brain ROI / knowledge suggestions** assume tools `Read`, `Grep`, Skill, Task, Claude cache fields  
6. **Skills catalog** only under `~/.claude/skills|scheduled-tasks|plugins`  
7. **Workspace/Brain rings** hard-coded `Path.home() / ".claude"` (+ `~/.claude.json` MCP)  
8. **Memory** only Claude memory dirs + global under `~/.claude`  
9. **Product copy / UX** Claude-centric throughout  

`agent_id` / `is_sidechain` are for **in-session Claude subagents**, not product identity.

### Minimal design to add a second source (e.g. Grok / Cursor / Codex)

| Layer | Change |
|-------|--------|
| **Schema** | Add `source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude'` (or `agent`) on `messages`, `tool_calls`, maybe `files`; include in PKs/indexes where needed; filter APIs |
| **Config** | Multi-root map: `{source, root, parser}` — e.g. env `AGENT_SOURCES` JSON or multiple `--projects-dir`-style flags |
| **Scanner** | Extract `TranscriptAdapter` interface: `discover()`, `parse_line()`, `normalize_usage()`, `normalize_tools()`; keep Claude adapter as-is; add Grok/etc. adapter |
| **Normalize** | Map foreign usage (prompt/completion, no cache, different field names) into existing columns; leave unused cache cols 0 |
| **Tools** | Either map foreign tools → Claude-like names for tips reuse, or make tips tool-name configurable per source |
| **Pricing** | Extend `pricing.json` + `cost_for` for non-Anthropic models (no opus/sonnet/haiku fallback) |
| **Queries/UI** | Optional `?source=` on overview/sessions/projects; badge source in Sessions |
| **Brain** | Decide: Claude-only memory forever vs per-source memory roots; ROI/suggestions currently Claude-tool-specific |
| **Scan loop** | `scan_dir` over all configured sources each tick |
| **Tests** | Fixtures per source + adapter unit tests |

### What you can reuse without rewrite

- SQLite + incremental `files` cursor model  
- Streaming-style dedup if the other tool has snapshot lines (key may differ from `message.id`)  
- Dashboard shell, ECharts, hash router  
- Session/project aggregations if rows normalize into `messages`  
- Cost plumbing once models are in `pricing.json`  

### Hardest gaps

1. **Transcript formats differ wildly** (Cursor DB/export, Codex logs, Grok CLI if any) — adapters are real work, not config.  
2. **Brain is a Claude product surface** (hooks, `~/.claude/projects/*/memory`, extraction sentinel). Multi-agent memory is a separate product decision.  
3. **Tips engine** is coupled to Claude tool semantics and cache metrics.  
4. **No abstraction boundary today** — Claude assumptions live in `scanner.py`, tips, memory ROI, skills, workspace, pricing, and UI copy.

### Practical recommendation

- **Phase A (usage only):** adapter + `source` column + multi-root scan + pricing entries + UI filter. Leave Brain/skills/tips Claude-only.  
- **Phase B:** generalize tips tool lists and cache charts per source.  
- **Phase C (optional):** multi-root or shared memory for Brain.

---

## Quick reference card

```
Transcripts:  ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl
DB:           ~/.claude/token-dashboard.db
Memory:       ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md
Global mem:   ~/.claude/memory/global/
Skills:       ~/.claude/skills, scheduled-tasks, plugins
Hooks (ext):  ~/.claude/hooks/ → memory_injections / memory_usage
Env:          CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR, TOKEN_DASHBOARD_DB, HOST, PORT, WORKSPACE_ROOTS
Scan:         rglob *.jsonl, mtime+byte offset, INSERT OR REPLACE + message_id dedup
Non-Claude:   not supported
```

# aiOs-dashboard multi-agent readiness report

## 1. Scanner: discovery, parse, paths, schema, format

### Pipeline

```
cli.py / server._scan_loop
  → scan_dir(projects_root, db)
  → root.rglob("*.jsonl")
  → incremental via files(path, mtime, bytes_read)
  → scan_file → parse_record → messages + tool_calls
```

**Critical files**

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/scanner.py` | Walk + parse + incremental ingest |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/db.py` | Schema, migrations, analytics queries |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/cli.py` | Paths, `scan` / `dashboard` entrypoints |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/server.py` | HTTP API, 30s rescan, SSE |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/pricing.py` | Cost from model name + usage |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/pricing.json` | Claude-only rates |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/tests/fixtures/sample_session.jsonl` | Canonical message shape |

### Data paths / env

| What | Default / resolution |
|------|----------------------|
| Transcript root | `~/.claude/projects` |
| Override | `--projects-dir` or `CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR` |
| Layout | `<projects>/<project-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl` |
| SQLite | `~/.claude/token-dashboard.db` |
| Override | `--db` or `TOKEN_DASHBOARD_DB` |
| Host/port | `HOST` (127.0.0.1), `PORT` (8080) |
| Workspace open roots | `WORKSPACE_ROOTS` (default `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer`) |

Discovery is **not** “Claude-aware” beyond path convention: any `*.jsonl` under the projects root is a candidate. Project slug = first path segment under the root.

Incremental rules (`scan_dir`):

- Same `mtime` + `bytes_read == size` → skip  
- Grown file → resume from `bytes_read`  
- Partial last line (no trailing `\n`) → do not advance high-water mark  
- `files` stores **last fully-parsed byte offset**, not always `st_size`

### SQLite tables

| Table | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `files` | Scan cursor: path, mtime, bytes_read, scanned_at |
| `messages` | One row per transcript line (after streaming dedup) |
| `tool_calls` | Tools + synthetic `_tool_result` rows |
| `plan` | Pricing plan preference (`k`/`v`) |
| `dismissed_tips` | Tips UX |
| `memory_injections` | Written by **external** hooks, read by Brain |
| `memory_usage` | Same |

**`messages` fields (Claude-shaped):**  
`uuid` (PK), `parent_uuid`, `session_id`, `project_slug`, `cwd`, `git_branch`, `cc_version`, `entrypoint`, `type`, `is_sidechain`, `agent_id`, `timestamp`, `model`, `stop_reason`, `prompt_id`, `message_id`, token columns (`input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_create_5m/1h`), `prompt_text`, `prompt_chars`, `tool_calls_json`.

**`tool_calls`:**  
`message_uuid`, `session_id`, `project_slug`, `tool_name`, `target`, `tool_use_id`, `result_tokens`, `is_error`, `timestamp`.

There is **no** `source` / `agent_type` / multi-vendor column.

### Message format assumptions (hard-coded Claude Code)

Top-level record:

- Required: `uuid`, `type`, `sessionId`, `timestamp`
- Optional: `parentUuid`, `cwd`, `gitBranch`, `version`, `entrypoint`, `isSidechain`, `agentId`, `promptId`
- Nested: `message.model`, `message.id`, `message.stop_reason`, `message.content`, `message.usage`

Usage map (Anthropic naming):

- `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`
- `cache_read_input_tokens` → `cache_read_tokens`
- `cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` / `ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`

Content:

- User text: string or list of `{type:"text"}` blocks  
- Tools: `type:"tool_use"` with Claude names (`Read`, `Edit`, `Write`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `Bash`, `WebFetch`, `WebSearch`, `Task`, `Skill`)  
- Results: `type:"tool_result"` → synthetic `_tool_result` with `chars//4` tokens  

Streaming dedup: same `(session_id, message_id)` keeps only latest `uuid` (`_evict_prior_snapshots`).

“Subagent” support is **Claude Code Task sidechains** only (`isSidechain` / `agentId`), not other products.

---

## 2. Non-Claude agent support?

**None.** Searches for `grok`, `openai`, `cursor`, `codex`, multi-agent source types hit only:

- CSS `cursor:`
- Claude `Task` → `subagent_type`
- Memory frontmatter `source: user|auto`
- Skills `source: user|plugin`

Pricing is Claude-only (`claude-opus-*`, `claude-sonnet-*`, `claude-haiku-*` + opus/sonnet/haiku tier fallback). Non-matching models → `usd: null`.

`docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` even notes **Claude Cowork** (same vendor, different path) is invisible if it doesn’t write local JSONL.

---

## 3. Brain / memory system

### Philosophy

Disk is source of truth. Brain **does not index memories into SQLite** on scan. Each `/api/brain` call re-reads markdown from disk.

### Paths

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md` | Per-project memories |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/MEMORY.md` | Index (pointers; not a graph node) |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/LEARNINGS.md` | Dated journal |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/AUDIT.md` | Skipped |
| `~/.claude/memory/global/` | Global tier as pseudo-project `slug=global` |
| `memory/.trash/` | Quarantine target |

**Note:** Global uses `~/.claude/memory/global`, not a full catalogue under `~/.claude/memory/INDEX.md` inside this repo. The dashboard does not read `INDEX.md`; it globs `*/memory/*.md` + the global dir.

### Key modules

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `token_dashboard/memory.py` | `get_brain`, ROI, suggestions, effectiveness, quarantine/promote |
| `token_dashboard/memory_parsing.py` | Frontmatter, learnings, coverage blobs, `GLOBAL_MEM_DIR` |
| `token_dashboard/workspace.py` | Brain rings layers: MCP / routines / skills from `~/.claude` |
| `web/routes/brain.js` | UI |
| `web/rings.js` | 3D rings canvas |

### Memory file format

YAML-like frontmatter (hand-parsed, not full YAML):

```yaml
---
name: ...
description: ...
metadata:
  type: project|...
  source: user|auto
  origin_session: ...
---
body with optional [[wikilinks]]
```

### APIs

| Endpoint | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| `GET /api/brain` | `get_brain(projects_dir, db, pricing)` |
| `POST /api/brain/remove` | Quarantine → `memory/.trash/` + strip MEMORY.md pointer |
| `POST /api/brain/keep` | Promote auto → `source: user` |
| `GET /api/workspace` | `scan_workspace(~/.claude)` apps/routines/skills |
| `POST /api/open` | Open path if under `WORKSPACE_ROOTS` or `~/.claude` |

### What Brain computes from SQLite (not from memory files)

- **Suggestions:** heavy `Read`/`Grep` targets without coverage in memory text  
- **ROI:** re-read tokens on covered files vs sessions whose `prompt_text` contains `MEMORY_EXTRACTION_PASS`  
- **Effectiveness:** join `memory_injections` (mode=`rank`) + `memory_usage`  

Those injection/usage tables are filled by **hooks outside this repo** (`~/.claude/hooks/memory-inject.py`, `memory-usage.py` — referenced in comments only).

### Graph links

1. Explicit `[[wikilink]]` → name match  
2. Soft TF-overlap edges (stdlib cosine-like, threshold 0.12)

No embeddings, no separate index DB for memory content.

---

## 4. Gap analysis: second agent source

### What is locked to Claude Code

1. **Single transcript root** (`CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR` only)  
2. **One parser** (`parse_record` + Anthropic usage + Claude tool names)  
3. **Schema** without `source` / vendor  
4. **Pricing** Claude tiers only  
5. **Tips / Brain ROI / knowledge suggestions** assume tools `Read`, `Grep`, Skill, Task, Claude cache fields  
6. **Skills catalog** only under `~/.claude/skills|scheduled-tasks|plugins`  
7. **Workspace/Brain rings** hard-coded `Path.home() / ".claude"` (+ `~/.claude.json` MCP)  
8. **Memory** only Claude memory dirs + global under `~/.claude`  
9. **Product copy / UX** Claude-centric throughout  

`agent_id` / `is_sidechain` are for **in-session Claude subagents**, not product identity.

### Minimal design to add a second source (e.g. Grok / Cursor / Codex)

| Layer | Change |
|-------|--------|
| **Schema** | Add `source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude'` (or `agent`) on `messages`, `tool_calls`, maybe `files`; include in PKs/indexes where needed; filter APIs |
| **Config** | Multi-root map: `{source, root, parser}` — e.g. env `AGENT_SOURCES` JSON or multiple `--projects-dir`-style flags |
| **Scanner** | Extract `TranscriptAdapter` interface: `discover()`, `parse_line()`, `normalize_usage()`, `normalize_tools()`; keep Claude adapter as-is; add Grok/etc. adapter |
| **Normalize** | Map foreign usage (prompt/completion, no cache, different field names) into existing columns; leave unused cache cols 0 |
| **Tools** | Either map foreign tools → Claude-like names for tips reuse, or make tips tool-name configurable per source |
| **Pricing** | Extend `pricing.json` + `cost_for` for non-Anthropic models (no opus/sonnet/haiku fallback) |
| **Queries/UI** | Optional `?source=` on overview/sessions/projects; badge source in Sessions |
| **Brain** | Decide: Claude-only memory forever vs per-source memory roots; ROI/suggestions currently Claude-tool-specific |
| **Scan loop** | `scan_dir` over all configured sources each tick |
| **Tests** | Fixtures per source + adapter unit tests |

### What you can reuse without rewrite

- SQLite + incremental `files` cursor model  
- Streaming-style dedup if the other tool has snapshot lines (key may differ from `message.id`)

# aiOs-dashboard multi-agent readiness report

## 1. Scanner: discovery, parse, paths, schema, format

### Pipeline

```
cli.py / server._scan_loop
  → scan_dir(projects_root, db)
  → root.rglob("*.jsonl")
  → incremental via files(path, mtime, bytes_read)
  → scan_file → parse_record → messages + tool_calls
```

**Critical files**

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/scanner.py` | Walk + parse + incremental ingest |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/db.py` | Schema, migrations, analytics queries |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/cli.py` | Paths, `scan` / `dashboard` entrypoints |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/server.py` | HTTP API, 30s rescan, SSE |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/token_dashboard/pricing.py` | Cost from model name + usage |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/pricing.json` | Claude-only rates |
| `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer/aiOs-dashboard/tests/fixtures/sample_session.jsonl` | Canonical message shape |

### Data paths / env

| What | Default / resolution |
|------|----------------------|
| Transcript root | `~/.claude/projects` |
| Override | `--projects-dir` or `CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR` |
| Layout | `<projects>/<project-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl` |
| SQLite | `~/.claude/token-dashboard.db` |
| Override | `--db` or `TOKEN_DASHBOARD_DB` |
| Host/port | `HOST` (127.0.0.1), `PORT` (8080) |
| Workspace open roots | `WORKSPACE_ROOTS` (default `/Volumes/SSD_CESAR/Developer`) |

Discovery is **not** “Claude-aware” beyond path convention: any `*.jsonl` under the projects root is a candidate. Project slug = first path segment under the root.

Incremental rules (`scan_dir`):

- Same `mtime` + `bytes_read == size` → skip  
- Grown file → resume from `bytes_read`  
- Partial last line (no trailing `\n`) → do not advance high-water mark  
- `files` stores **last fully-parsed byte offset**, not always `st_size`

### SQLite tables

| Table | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `files` | Scan cursor: path, mtime, bytes_read, scanned_at |
| `messages` | One row per transcript line (after streaming dedup) |
| `tool_calls` | Tools + synthetic `_tool_result` rows |
| `plan` | Pricing plan preference (`k`/`v`) |
| `dismissed_tips` | Tips UX |
| `memory_injections` | Written by **external** hooks, read by Brain |
| `memory_usage` | Same |

**`messages` fields (Claude-shaped):**  
`uuid` (PK), `parent_uuid`, `session_id`, `project_slug`, `cwd`, `git_branch`, `cc_version`, `entrypoint`, `type`, `is_sidechain`, `agent_id`, `timestamp`, `model`, `stop_reason`, `prompt_id`, `message_id`, token columns (`input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_create_5m/1h`), `prompt_text`, `prompt_chars`, `tool_calls_json`.

**`tool_calls`:**  
`message_uuid`, `session_id`, `project_slug`, `tool_name`, `target`, `tool_use_id`, `result_tokens`, `is_error`, `timestamp`.

There is **no** `source` / `agent_type` / multi-vendor column.

### Message format assumptions (hard-coded Claude Code)

Top-level record:

- Required: `uuid`, `type`, `sessionId`, `timestamp`
- Optional: `parentUuid`, `cwd`, `gitBranch`, `version`, `entrypoint`, `isSidechain`, `agentId`, `promptId`
- Nested: `message.model`, `message.id`, `message.stop_reason`, `message.content`, `message.usage`

Usage map (Anthropic naming):

- `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`
- `cache_read_input_tokens` → `cache_read_tokens`
- `cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` / `ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`

Content:

- User text: string or list of `{type:"text"}` blocks  
- Tools: `type:"tool_use"` with Claude names (`Read`, `Edit`, `Write`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `Bash`, `WebFetch`, `WebSearch`, `Task`, `Skill`)  
- Results: `type:"tool_result"` → synthetic `_tool_result` with `chars//4` tokens  

Streaming dedup: same `(session_id, message_id)` keeps only latest `uuid` (`_evict_prior_snapshots`).

“Subagent” support is **Claude Code Task sidechains** only (`isSidechain` / `agentId`), not other products.

---

## 2. Non-Claude agent support?

**None.** Searches for `grok`, `openai`, `cursor`, `codex`, multi-agent source types hit only:

- CSS `cursor:`
- Claude `Task` → `subagent_type`
- Memory frontmatter `source: user|auto`
- Skills `source: user|plugin`

Pricing is Claude-only (`claude-opus-*`, `claude-sonnet-*`, `claude-haiku-*` + opus/sonnet/haiku tier fallback). Non-matching models → `usd: null`.

`docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` even notes **Claude Cowork** (same vendor, different path) is invisible if it doesn’t write local JSONL.

---

## 3. Brain / memory system

### Philosophy

Disk is source of truth. Brain **does not index memories into SQLite** on scan. Each `/api/brain` call re-reads markdown from disk.

### Paths

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md` | Per-project memories |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/MEMORY.md` | Index (pointers; not a graph node) |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/LEARNINGS.md` | Dated journal |
| `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/AUDIT.md` | Skipped |
| `~/.claude/memory/global/` | Global tier as pseudo-project `slug=global` |
| `memory/.trash/` | Quarantine target |

**Note:** Global uses `~/.claude/memory/global`, not a full catalogue under `~/.claude/memory/INDEX.md` inside this repo. The dashboard does not read `INDEX.md`; it globs `*/memory/*.md` + the global dir.

### Key modules

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `token_dashboard/memory.py` | `get_brain`, ROI, suggestions, effectiveness, quarantine/promote |
| `token_dashboard/memory_parsing.py` | Frontmatter, learnings, coverage blobs, `GLOBAL_MEM_DIR` |
| `token_dashboard/workspace.py` | Brain rings layers: MCP / routines / skills from `~/.claude` |
| `web/routes/brain.js` | UI |
| `web/rings.js` | 3D rings canvas |

### Memory file format

YAML-like frontmatter (hand-parsed, not full YAML):

```yaml
---
name: ...
description: ...
metadata:
  type: project|...
  source: user|auto
  origin_session: ...
---
body with optional [[wikilinks]]
```

### APIs

| Endpoint | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| `GET /api/brain` | `get_brain(projects_dir, db, pricing)` |
| `POST /api/brain/remove` | Quarantine → `memory/.trash/` + strip MEMORY.md pointer |
| `POST /api/brain/keep` | Promote auto → `source: user` |
| `GET /api/workspace` | `scan_workspace(~/.claude)` apps/routines/skills |
| `POST /api/open` | Open path if under `WORKSPACE_ROOTS` or `~/.claude` |

### What Brain computes from SQLite (not from memory files)

- **Suggestions:** heavy `Read`/`Grep` targets without coverage in memory text  
- **ROI:** re-read tokens on covered files vs sessions whose `prompt_text` contains `MEMORY_EXTRACTION_PASS`  
- **Effectiveness:** join `memory_injections` (mode=`rank`) + `memory_usage`  

Those injection/usage tables are filled by **hooks outside this repo** (`~/.claude/hooks/memory-inject.py`, `memory-usage.py` — referenced in comments only).

### Graph links

1. Explicit `[[wikilink]]` → name match  
2. Soft TF-overlap edges (stdlib cosine-like, threshold 0.12)

No embeddings, no separate index DB for memory content.

---

## 4. Gap analysis: second agent source

### What is locked to Claude Code

1. **Single transcript root** (`CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR` only)  
2. **One parser** (`parse_record` + Anthropic usage + Claude tool names)  
3. **Schema** without `source` / vendor  
4. **Pricing** Claude tiers only  
5. **Tips / Brain ROI / knowledge suggestions** assume tools `Read`, `Grep`, Skill, Task, Claude cache fields  
6. **Skills catalog** only under `~/.claude/skills|scheduled-tasks|plugins`  
7. **Workspace/Brain rings** hard-coded `Path.home() / ".claude"` (+ `~/.claude.json` MCP)  
8. **Memory** only Claude memory dirs + global under `~/.claude`  
9. **Product copy / UX** Claude-centric throughout  

`agent_id` / `is_sidechain` are for **in-session Claude subagents**, not product identity.

### Minimal design to add a second source (e.g. Grok / Cursor / Codex)

| Layer | Change |
|-------|--------|
| **Schema** | Add `source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude'` (or `agent`) on `messages`, `tool_calls`, maybe `files`; include in PKs/indexes where needed; filter APIs |
| **Config** | Multi-root map: `{source, root, parser}` — e.g. env `AGENT_SOURCES` JSON or multiple `--projects-dir`-style flags |
| **Scanner** | Extract `TranscriptAdapter` interface: `discover()`, `parse_line()`, `normalize_usage()`, `normalize_tools()`; keep Claude adapter as-is; add Grok/etc. adapter |
| **Normalize** | Map foreign usage (prompt/completion, no cache, different field names) into existing columns; leave unused cache cols 0 |
| **Tools** | Either map foreign tools → Claude-like names for tips reuse, or make tips tool-name configurable per source |
| **Pricing** | Extend `pricing.json` + `cost_for` for non-Anthropic models (no opus/sonnet/haiku fallback) |
| **Queries/UI** | Optional `?source=` on overview/sessions/projects; badge source in Sessions |
| **Brain** | Decide: Claude-only memory forever vs per-source memory roots; ROI/suggestions currently Claude-tool-specific |
| **Scan loop** | `scan_dir` over all configured sources each tick |
| **Tests** | Fixtures per source + adapter unit tests |

### What you can reuse without rewrite

- SQLite + incremental `files` cursor model  
- Streaming-style dedup if the other tool has snapshot lines (key may differ from `message.id`)  
- Dashboard shell, ECharts, hash router  
- Session/project aggregations if rows normalize into `messages`  
- Cost plumbing once models are in `pricing.json`  

### Hardest gaps

1. **Transcript formats differ wildly** (Cursor DB/export, Codex logs, Grok CLI if any) — adapters are real work, not config.  
2. **Brain is a Claude product surface** (hooks, `~/.claude/projects/*/memory`, extraction sentinel). Multi-agent memory is a separate product decision.  
3. **Tips engine** is coupled to Claude tool semantics and cache metrics.  
4. **No abstraction boundary today** — Claude assumptions live in `scanner.py`, tips, memory ROI, skills, workspace, pricing, and UI copy.

### Practical recommendation

- **Phase A (usage only):** adapter + `source` column + multi-root scan + pricing entries + UI filter. Leave Brain/skills/tips Claude-only.  
- **Phase B:** generalize tips tool lists and cache charts per source.  
- **Phase C (optional):** multi-root or shared memory for Brain.

---

```
Memory:       ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md
```

content.text:
1→# Session Management

Grok saves every conversation to disk automatically. Whether you work in the TUI, in headless mode, or over agent stdio, Grok records the exchange as a session. You can resume, rewind, or compact it. This document describes how to manage sessions.

---

## What Sessions Are

A session is a persistent conversation with full history. It includes:
10→
- All user prompts and agent responses
- Tool calls and their results
- TODO/task list state
- File snapshots for rewind
- Token usage and turn counts
- Subagent sessions (when enabled)

Sessions are identified by a unique session ID (a UUIDv7 when Grok generates it; a client may supply its own ID with `-s`) and stored on disk under `~/.grok/sessions/`. Set `GROK_HOME` to override the base directory; when it is unset, Grok uses `~/.grok`.

20→---

## Storage Layout

Grok stores each session in its own directory, grouped by working directory. It URL-encodes the working directory to name the group. When the encoded name exceeds 255 bytes, it instead uses a slug plus a hash and records the original path in a `.cwd` file inside the group.

```
~/.grok/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/
  summary.json            # metadata: summary/title, timestamps, model ID, message counts
  updates.jsonl           # ACP session update stream (conversation + tool calls)
30→  chat_history.jsonl      # raw chat messages sent to the model
  plan.json               # TODO/task list state
  rewind_points.jsonl     # file snapshots for /rewind undo
  signals.json            # session signals (token usage, tool/turn counters)
  feedback.jsonl          # user feedback and ratings
  compaction_checkpoints/ # saved state from compaction (manual or auto)
```

import sys,json
for i,l in enumerate(sys.stdin):

  # print compact preview of nested structure
  def preview(x, depth=0, maxd=3):
    if depth>maxd: return "..."
    if isinstance(x, dict):
      return {k: preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for k,v in list(x.items())[:20]}
    if isinstance(x, list):
      return [preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for v in x[:3]] + (["..."] if len(x)>3 else [])

    return x

echo '=== chat_history first 3 lines (truncated) ==='
head -3 "$SID/chat_history.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c '
import sys,json
for i,l in enumerate(sys.stdin):
  o=json.loads(l)
  print("keys:", sorted(o.keys()))
  # print compact preview of nested structure
  def preview(x, depth=0, maxd=3):
    if depth>maxd: return "..."
    if isinstance(x, dict):
      return {k: preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for k,v in list(x.items())[:20]}
    if isinstance(x, list):
      return [preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for v in x[:3]] + (["..."] if len(x)>3 else [])
    if isinstance(x, str) and len(x)>80: return x[:80]+"..."
    return x
  print(json.dumps(preview(o), indent=2)[:2500])
  print("---")
'
echo '=== events first line keys ==='
head -1 "$SID/events.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; o=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print(sorted(o.keys())); print(json.dumps({k:(type(v).__name__ if not isinstance(v,(str,int,float,bool,type(None))) else v) for k,v in o.items()}, indent=2)[:1500])'

ls ~/.claude/projects/*/memory 2>/dev/null | head -20

rawOutput.command:
# Sample Grok session structure and formats
S=$(ls -d ~/.grok/sessions/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "Sample workspace: $S"
ls -la "$S" 2>/dev/null | head -20
SID=$(ls -d ~/.grok/sessions/*/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "Sample session: $SID"
ls -la "$SID"
echo '=== chat_history first 3 lines (truncated) ==='
head -3 "$SID/chat_history.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c '
import sys,json
for i,l in enumerate(sys.stdin):
  o=json.loads(l)
  print("keys:", sorted(o.keys()))
  # print compact preview of nested structure
  def preview(x, depth=0, maxd=3):
    if depth>maxd: return "..."
    if isinstance(x, dict):
      return {k: preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for k,v in list(x.items())[:20]}
    if isinstance(x, list):
      return [preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for v in x[:3]] + (["..."] if len(x)>3 else [])
    if isinstance(x, str) and len(x)>80: return x[:80]+"..."
    return x
  print(json.dumps(preview(o), indent=2)[:2500])
  print("---")
'
echo '=== events first line keys ==='
head -1 "$SID/events.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; o=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print(sorted(o.keys())); print(json.dumps({k:(type(v).__name__ if not isinstance(v,(str,int,float,bool,type(None))) else v) for k,v in o.items()}, indent=2)[:1500])'
echo '=== grok memory ==='
find ~/.grok/memory -type f 2>/dev/null | head -30
ls -la ~/.grok/memory/
echo '=== claude memory sample ==='
ls ~/.claude/memory/ 2>/dev/null
ls ~/.claude/projects/*/memory 2>/dev/null | head -20
# check if any grok project has memory
find ~/.grok -name 'MEMORY.md' -o -name 'memory' -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20
# models_cache for pricing
python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/Users/cesar/.grok/models_cache.json")); print(type(d), list(d)[:10] if isinstance(d,dict) else d[:2] if isinstance(d,list) else d)' 2>/dev/null | head -5
cat ~/.grok/models_cache.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d, indent=2)[:2000])'

# Sample Grok session structure and formats
S=$(ls -d ~/.grok/sessions/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "Sample workspace: $S"
ls -la "$S" 2>/dev/null | head -20
SID=$(ls -d ~/.grok/sessions/*/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "Sample session: $SID"
ls -la "$SID"
echo '=== chat_history first 3 lines (truncated) ==='
head -3 "$SID/chat_history.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c '
import sys,json
for i,l in enumerate(sys.stdin):
  o=json.loads(l)
  print("keys:", sorted(o.keys()))
  # print compact preview of nested structure
  def preview(x, depth=0, maxd=3):
    if depth>maxd: return "..."
    if isinstance(x, dict):
      return {k: preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for k,v in list(x.items())[:20]}
    if isinstance(x, list):
      return [preview(v, depth+1, maxd) for v in x[:3]] + (["..."] if len(x)>3 else [])
    if isinstance(x, str) and len(x)>80: return x[:80]+"..."
    return x
  print(json.dumps(preview(o), indent=2)[:2500])
  print("---")
'
echo '=== events first line keys ==='
head -1 "$SID/events.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; o=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print(sorted(o.keys())); print(json.dumps({k:(type(v).__name__ if not isinstance(v,(str,int,float,bool,type(None))) else v) for k,v in o.items()}, indent=2)[:1500])'
echo '=== grok memory ==='
find ~/.grok/memory -type f 2>/dev/null | head -30
ls -la ~/.grok/memory/
echo '=== claude memory sample ==='
ls ~/.claude/memory/ 2>/dev/null
ls ~/.claude/projects/*/memory 2>/dev/null | head -20
# check if any grok project has memory
find ~/.grok -name 'MEMORY.md' -o -name 'memory' -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20
# models_cache for pricing
python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/Users/cesar/.grok/models_cache.json")); print(type(d), list(d)[:10] if isinstance(d,dict) else d[:2] if isinstance(d,list) else d)' 2>/dev/null | head -5
cat ~/.grok/models_cache.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d, indent=2)[:2000])'
